title: Fish heading and left/right convention shared by Palette and Citrus

consumers.artifact: citrus.pose_observation v2 contract_json.heading_definition_ref and the derived heading in /observations/pose/objects
body frame v1 and intake checks on citrus.pose_observation v2

frame.crop_rule: a per-camera crop is a pure translation of the full frame, so the angle is identical in both
frame.camera_view_note: The handedness id below is meaningful only for a non-mirrored top-down view. A producer declares the view it assumed per session (citrus.pose_observation v2 contract_json.camera_view_assumed). No shared contract measures mirror/AOI or projector orientation yet (Palette coordinate-spaces proposal pending).

keypoints.recipe_carrier: pose_schema.metadata.heading_computation in the model sidecar (ops keypoint and midpoint); Citrus resolves the recipe by skeleton node name, never by hard-coded anatomy
keypoints.fallback: none: any of the three missing or non-finite makes heading unknown; never velocity, interpolation, neighbouring frames or another keypoint
keypoints.confidence: gates usability only; it never changes the value. Palette offline refinement requires all three confidences >= 0.3 plus triangle geometry; Citrus applies its own minimum_keypoint_confidence as an admission gate. Neither is part of this definition.

angle.positive_rotation: counter-clockwise as seen on the image (+90 = image up)
angle.range_rule: -180 and +180 denote the same heading. An exactly horizontal forward (forward_y == 0, common with quantised integer keypoints) gives atan2(-0.0, negative) = -180 in IEEE arithmetic; neither producer normalises it. Comparisons use wrap_delta (|wrap_delta(a - b)| <= tolerance), never raw equality.

degenerate.rule: |forward| <= epsilon is degenerate_forward_axis; each producer declares its epsilon

angle.valid_row_invariant: wrap_delta(heading_angle_degrees - degrees(atan2(-heading_direction_y, heading_direction_x))) == 0 (within tolerance), with direction the unit forward vector in y-down coordinates

left_right.point_on_left: dot(p - origin, left_axis) > 0, equivalently cross(forward, p - origin) = f_x*v_y - f_y*v_x < 0 in y-down coordinates
left_right.egocentric_bearing: atan2(dot(v, left_axis), dot(v, forward)): 0 = ahead, +90 = left
left_right.eye_check: a row is valid only if dot(eye_left - eye_right, left_axis) > 0; the labels are never swapped to make it pass (Palette corrects eye flips earlier, offline)

unknown.encoding: NaN in every derived float plus a validity flag or status
unknown.producer_specific_reasons: a producer may add its own prefixed reasons (Citrus: citrus_no_pose, citrus_unresolved_metadata, citrus_identity_mismatch, citrus_low_confidence, citrus_policy_disabled) for gates this definition does not cover

smoothing.rule: no minimum-displacement rule and no realtime smoothing in the definition. Palette smooths offline (centred circular box filter over cos/sin, window round(fps*0.05)). A realtime producer logs the raw per-frame heading it used; any smoothed or held value is a separate field, so Palette can recompute and compare exactly.

projection.rule: The heading is defined in camera pixels only. A consumer that needs it in another plane (projector canvas, arena) maps two points, origin and origin + forward, through the fitted camera-to-plane homography and takes their difference; it never reuses the camera angle, which is correct only when the homography has no rotation or reflection (omnifin0 arena 1's active homography carries a y reflection: camera 90 deg maps to canvas 270 deg).

not_this: Palette Megabouts tail_posture head_yaw: head to tail base, no y flip, radians
Palette chaser-centred bearing in chaser_escape_freeze_summary: positive clockwise
Palette visualization fallback to motion heading

Citrus pose_observation v1 heading_angle_degrees: atan2(dy, dx) clockwise positive in [0, 360); convert with angle_v2 = ((-angle_v1 + 180) mod 360) - 180 (lands in [-180, 180); compare under wrap_delta)
